designBasis.summary: Production candidate item catalog for the current tile-grid roguelite loop. Effects are tuned for board, hand, discard, movement, shop, and settlement decisions.
referencePatterns: Limited battle utilities with explicit slot pressure
Run-long equipment and passive rack modifiers
Shop economy tools that preserve player purchase choice
Rarity-weighted utility effects for tile-grid pressure points
policy: Do not merge item slots into tactic card slots.
Use item subtype and placement to determine battle and shop behavior.
Store ids and state counters, not localized text.
Prefer small numeric effects that are easy to verify before the final balance pass.
